External storage and publication decisions remain unverified, so no effective dependency closure is claimed.
dependency_graph_complete_for: 37 readiness files: Markdown links, JSON artifact/source path strings and current evidence artifactHashes; existing canonical reading targets recorded separately. Historical source byte identity is not inferred from current targets.

backup.disposition: BACKUP_ONLY — preserve locally; do not publish archive automatically
backup.restore_or_privacy_inspection: NOT_EXECUTED; cannot substitute for organized evidence

crlf.expected_with_minus_text: No text clean/smudge conversion; blob and checkout bytes remain CRLF, raw_git_blob and original_sha256. This is conditional on approved exact-path attribute and verification in the actual later staging/checkout environment.
crlf.proof: git hash-object --stdin versus git hash-object --path=<exact path> --stdin; no -w. Unfiltered hash proves expected no-text-conversion byte identity; no index, checkout or attribute mutation tested.
crlf.unrelated_attribute_effect: Proposed literal path has no glob metacharacters; one inventory target. No .gitattributes bytes changed, no index or checkout executed; no empirical filtered checkout PASS claimed.

must_not_publish_rule: Do not publish actual secrets, credentials, real PHI or unnecessary local-machine context. Bounded scan found no credential-pattern match, which is not full privacy clearance. Retain raw local-context/historical bytes privately; approve a minimized public derivative and reference resolution separately if needed. No redaction/rewriting of approved evidence performed.
